title: Check if Array is Sorted and Rotated

content.problemStatement:
Sorted and rotated

Given an array of N distinct integers. the task is to write a program to check if this array is sorted and rotated. A sorted array is not considered as sorted and rotated , i.e there should at least one rotation.
content.inputFormat:
The first line has an integer N denotes the size of the array.

The second line contains N values separated by space.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Check if array is sorted and circularly rotated.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    n = int(toks[0])
    arr = [int(x) for x in toks[1:n+1]]
    count = sum(1 for i in range(n) if arr[i] > arr[(i + 1) % n])
    print("Yes" if count <= 1 else "No")
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

solution.editorial: Count indices where a[i] > a[(i + 1) % n]. If count <= 1, print Yes, else No.

hints: Count circular inversion drops a[i] > a[(i+1)%n].
